title: Set up #permafleet for PERMAFLEET
description: Gives a member org's pilots a #permafleet channel for alliance talk. goon.vc's bot creates it, or the server's own channel is used.

welcome.say: Hi {{user.name}}! A **#permafleet** channel gives your pilots a place for alliance talk: ops, plans, and news from across the Protectorate. Let's set one up on **{{context.guildName}}**.

channel.say: Should goon.vc's bot create #permafleet? That's the recommended way: it's set up the same on every member org's Discord. Or pick a channel **{{context.guildName}}** already has.

category.say: Which category should #permafleet go in? It stays open to everyone on your server, whatever the category allows.

permissions.say:
To create #permafleet, goon.vc's bot needs **Manage Channels**, plus the permissions it opens up there. Missing on **{{context.guildName}}** right now: {{context.channelMissing}}.
Grant them with this link (it updates the bot if it's already in your server), then press Continue: {{context.channelInviteUrl}}

summary.say:
Here's the plan for **{{context.guildName}}**:
- Create #permafleet, where everyone on your server can read and post
- Category: {{labels.category|none, top of the channel list}}

Go ahead?

existing.say:
I'll use {{labels.channel}} as #permafleet on **{{context.guildName}}** and leave its permissions as they are.

Go ahead?

cancelled.say: Nothing changed. Run `/goon permafleet` in your server to start again.
